summary: In India, the advice is to wait and hold cash, with HDFC Bank as the preferred choice if buying anyway. In America, the pick is to buy JPMorgan Chase cautiously. Analysts note HDFC Bank has fallen about seventeen percent from its peak and faces pressure from its merger integration. They also mention that with only ten dollars you cannot join any US initial public offering, and a ten thousand rupee purchase of Reliance in India costs roughly thirty-eight rupees in fees.
